main_text.p: שְׁגָגָה f. Error; peccatum ex ignorantia, Num.15.28.
מִשְׁגָּה f. Idem: Aff. אֲתִי תָלִין מִשְׁגָּתִי [?] Mecum morabitur error meus, Job.19.14. quod formam à שוג habet.

שָׁגָה Erravit, Aberravit, Oberravit: Praeterit. וּמַה־שָּׁגִיתִי [?] Et in quo erraverim, Job.6.v.24. Partic. וְכָל שֹׁגֵה בּוֹ [?] Et quisquis oberrat in eo, Prov.20.1. Hiph. Partic. מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר Errare faciens caecum, Job.12.16.
שְׁגִיאוֹת f.p. Errores: שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי יָבִין [?] Errores quis intelligit, Psalm.19.13.

שְׁגִין m. Cantio erratica, Psal.7.1. id est, Varia, quae omnibus rationibus musica decantabatur simul. Vocabulum musicum est, cujus ratio Hebraeis ignota: Plur. Foem. שְׁגִיּוֹנוֹת [?] Odae erraticae vel mixtae, Hab.3.1.
* שָׁגָה, שָׁגְשֵׁג [?] Vide supra in שנא.

שָׁגַח Hiph. הִשְׁגִּיחַ Prospexit, Respexit, Confide-ravit [?]: Praeter. הִשְׁגִּיחַ Prospicit in omnes habitatores terrae, Psalm.33.14. Particip. מַשְׁגִּיחַ מִן־הַחַלּוֹנוֹת [?] Prospiciens è fenestris, Cant.2.9. Futur. אֵלֶיךָ יַשְׁגִּיחוּ [?] Ad te respicient, Jesa.14.16.

שָׁגַל Vitiare, Violare mulierem. Verbum est Hebrais actum Venereum propriissimè denominans, ac proinde pronunciatu obscaenum in communi sermone ipsis habitum. Unde Masoretha Verbum שָׁכַב Cubuit, Concubuit, pro eo legendum substituerunt, quomodo Germani dicunt Beyschlaffen / Beyligen. Similem correctionem vide infra in שין. Vide Rambam in More p.3.c.8. circa finem. Futur. יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה [?] Vitiabit eam, Deut.28.30. legendum יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה Cubabit cum ea. Niph.Futur. וְנִשְׁגְּלוּ [?] Et foemina eorum vitiabuntur; legendum תִּשְׁכַּבְנָה [?] Concubitu violabuntur, Jesf.13.16. Item Zach.14.2. Pyh. Praeter. אִשָּׁה לֹא שֻׁגְלָה [?] Ubi non fuerū vitiata; legendum שְׁכֻבָּה, Jerem.3.2.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms in the Latin glosses are small and partly uncertain; those I could not read with confidence are marked [?]. The running head is a single Hebrew letter group (שנ) and is marked [?]. Print sits clean; the dark spots are stains and not text.
